subject: Scheduling: Dedicated/Private demo — EU DPO & APAC security reviewers
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>

Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.inference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Scheduling: Dedicated/Private demo — EU DPO & APAC security reviewers

Hi Anja,

Thanks again for the time on the call last week — excited to continue the conversation about a dedicated/private deployment for Orion HealthTech. Per our discussion, we'd like to run a technical demo focused on security controls, network isolation, and audit logging. Important ask: could you confirm the EU DPO and the APAC security lead who should join? We want their availability so we schedule a time that works for all regional reviewers.

To avoid DST confusion I pulled a few candidate windows (local times + UTC). Please let me know which works best or propose alternatives:

- Thu Apr 22, 09:00–10:00 BST (08:00–09:00 UTC) — early EU-friendly slot
- Thu Apr 22, 16:00–17:00 BST (15:00–16:00 UTC) — works for US late morning / EU afternoon
- Fri Apr 23, 02:00–03:00 JST (17:00–18:00 UTC Thu) — APAC late slot (we know this is late for EU)

We can run a single session with two short segments (security Q&A for regional reviewers + demo for the engineering team). Attached is a draft agenda and a short security questionnaire the team asked for.

If helpful, Dylan will lead the demo and Connor will cover deployment/ops details.

Thanks — happy to move things around to accommodate your DPO and Kenji in APAC.

Best,
Marissa
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Attachments: demo-agenda.pdf, security-questionnaire.xlsx

Thanks — we can make time for a combined session. I am the EU DPO and will join personally. For APAC we need Kenji Sato (APAC security lead) on the call. I've looped him in on this thread (cc below).

- Thu Apr 22: 09:00–10:30 CEST (07:00–08:30 UTC) — preferred

Thanks Anja — and hi Kenji, nice to e-meet.

We can accommodate the EU preferred time. To confirm the final plan:

Option A (preferred by EU):
- Thu Apr 22 09:30–11:00 CEST (07:30–09:00 UTC) — Security-focused first 30m (Anja + Kenji), then 60m demo & ops walkthrough for engineering/infra folks

Option B (APAC-friendly alternative):
- Thu Apr 22 23:00–00:30 JST (14:00–15:30 UTC) — leans late for EU DPO but could work if Kenji prefers local hours

Practical notes:
- We'll prepare a short recording of the demo in case parts are outside someone's working hours.
- Attached updated agenda; I'll send a calendar invite after we lock the time.

Can everyone confirm Option A works (09:30 CEST / 07:30 UTC)? If not, pick Option B or propose a single alternative time.

Cheers,
Marissa
